External System Outage Handling, Cached Fallback, Cross
Domain Failover, DR Testing, and Replay After Outage
External systems fail. PlantSafety must not.
Cross-domain DR targets must meet the following minimums:
RTO (Recovery Time Objective): Cross-domain sync must resume within 15 minutes of external system restoration
RPO (Recovery Point Objective): No more than 1 full sync cycle of data loss (e.g., max 1 hour for HRIS, max 15 minutes for MES)
Cached fallback data must remain valid for a minimum of 24 hours during external system outage
